verses.translation: This is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

translations.ron: Aceasta este cartea poruncilor lui Dumnezeu şi legea care dăinuieşte în veac; toţi cei ce o ţin vor trăi, iar cei ce au părăsit-o vor pieri.
translations.grk: Αὑτὴ ἡ βίβλος τῶν προσταγμάτων τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ ὁ νόμος ὁ ὑπάρχων εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· πάντες οἱ κρατοῦντες αὐτὴν, εἰς ζωήν· οἱ δὲ καταλείποντες αὐτὴν, ἀποθανοῦνται.

verses.translation: Turn thee, O Jacob, and take hold of it: walk in the presence of the light thereof, that thou mayest be illuminated.

translations.ron: Întoarce-te, Iacove, şi te teme de ea, umblă prin strălucire în preajma luminii ei.
translations.grk: Ἐπιστρέφου Ἱακὼβ, καὶ ἐπιλαβοῦ αὐτῆς, διόδευσον πρὸς τὴν λάμψιν κατέναντι τοῦ φωτὸς αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Give not thine honour to another, nor the things that are profitable unto thee to a strange nation.

translations.ron: Nu da altuia mărirea ta şi cele de folos ţie, celui de alt neam.
translations.grk: Μὴ δῷς ἑτέρῳ τὴν δόξαν σου, καὶ τὰ συμφέροντά σοι ἔθνει ἀλλοτρίῳ.

verses.translation: O Israel, happy are we: for things that are pleasing to God are made known unto us.

translations.ron: Fericiţi suntem, Israele, că cele ce Îi plac lui Dumnezeu ni s-au arătat.
translations.grk: Μακάριοι ἐσμὲν Ἰσραὴλ, ὅτι τὰ ἀρεστὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῖν γνωστά ἐστι.

verses.translation: Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Israel.

translations.ron: Îndrăzneşte, poporul meu, pomenirea lui Israel.
translations.grk: Θαρσεῖτε λαός μου, μνημόσυνον Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Ye were sold to the nations, not for [your] destruction: but because ye moved God to wrath, ye were delivered unto the enemies.

translations.ron: Vândutu-v-aţi neamurilor nu spre pieire, ci, pentru că aţi mâniat pe Dumnezeu, v-aţi dat vrăjmaşilor.
translations.grk: Ἐπράθητε τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὐκ εἰς ἀπώλειαν, διὰ τὸ παροργίσαι ὑμᾶς τὸν Θεόν· παρεδόθητε τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις.

verses.translation: For ye provoked him that made you by sacrificing unto devils and not to God.

translations.ron: Pentru că aţi întărâtat pe Cel care v-a făcut, jertfind demonilor, şi nu lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Παρωξύνατε γὰρ τὸν ποιήσαντα ὑμᾶς, θύσαντες δαιμονίοις, καὶ οὐ Θεῷ.

verses.translation: Ye have forgotten the everlasting God, that brought you up; and ye have grieved Jerusalem, that nursed you.

translations.ron: Şi aţi uitat pe Cel care v-a zidit, pe Dumnezeul cel Veşnic, şi aţi întristat Ierusalimul care v-a hrănit.
translations.grk: Ἐπελάθεσθε τὸν τροφεύσαντα ὑμᾶς Θεὸν αἰώνιον, ἐλυπήσατε δὲ καὶ τὴν ἐκθρέψασαν ἡμᾶς Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.translation: For when she saw the wrath of God coming upon you, she said, Hearken, O ye that dwell about Sion: God hath brought upon me great mourning;

translations.ron: Văzut-a el mânia care v-a venit de la Dumnezeu şi a zis: Auziţi, vecinele Sionului, Dumnezeu mi-a adus întristare mare,
translations.grk: Εἶδε γὰρ τὴν ἐπελθοῦσαν ὑμῖν ὀργὴν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν, ἀκούσατε αἱ πάροικοι Σιὼν, ἐπήγαγέ μοι ὁ Θεὸς πένθος μέγα.

verses.translation: for I saw the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.

translations.ron: Că am văzut robirea fiilor mei şi a fiicelor mele pe care le-a adus lor Cel Veşnic.
translations.grk: Εἶδον γὰρ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων, ἣν ἐπήγαγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ αἰώνιος.

verses.translation: With joy did I nourish them; but sent them away with weeping and mourning.

translations.ron: Că i-am hrănit cu bucurie şi i-am slobozit cu plângere şi cu jale.
translations.grk: Ἔθρεψα γὰρ αὐτοὺς μετʼ εὐφροσύνης, ἐξαπέστειλα δὲ μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ πένθους.

verses.translation: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sins of my children am left desolate; because they departed from the law of God.

translations.ron: Nimeni să nu se bucure de mine, care sînt văduvă şi părăsită de mulţi; am fost pustiită pentru păcatele copiilor mei, abătuţi de la legea lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Μηδεὶς ἐπιχαιρέτω μοι τῇ χήρᾳ καὶ καταλειφθήσῃ ὑπὸ πολλῶν, ἠρημώθην διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας τῶν τέκνων μου, διότι ἐξέκλιναν ἐκ νόμου Θεοῦ,

verses.translation: They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.

translations.ron: Şi judecăţile Lui nu le-au cunoscut, nici n-au umblat în căile poruncilor lui Dumnezeu, nici pe cărările învăţăturii în dreptatea Lui n-au mers.
translations.grk: καὶ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν, οὐδὲ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδοῖς ἐντολῶν Θεοῦ, οὐδὲ τρίβους παιδείας ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ αὐτοῦ ἐπέβησαν.

verses.translation: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember ye the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting hath brought upon them.

translations.ron: Veniţi, vecinele Sionului, şi vă aduceţi aminte de robirea fiilor şi a fiicelor mele, pe care le-a adus-o Cel Veşnic.
translations.grk: Ἐλθέτωσαν αἱ πάροικοι Σιὼν, καὶ μνήσθητε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ θυγατέρων, ἣν ἐπήγαγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ αἰώνιος.

verses.translation: For he hath brought a nation upon them from far, a shameless nation, and of a strange language, who neither reverenced old man, nor pitied child,

translations.ron: Că a adus peste ei neam de departe, neam fără de ruşine şi de altă limbă.
translations.grk: Ἐπήγαγε γὰρ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἔθνος μακρόθεν, ἔθνος ἀναιδὲς καὶ ἀλλόγλωσσον· ὅτι οὐκ ᾐσχύνθησαν πρεσβύτην, οὐδὲ παιδίον ἠλέησαν,

verses.translation: and they have carried away the dear beloved children of the widow, and left her that was alone desolate without daughters.

translations.ron: Că nu s-au ruşinat de cel bătrân, nici nu le-a fost milă de prunc şi au luat pe cei iubiţi ai văduvei, şi pe mine m-au lăsat singură, fără de fiice.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀπήγαγον τοὺς ἀγαπητοὺς τῆς χήρας, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τὴν μόνην ἠρήμωσαν.

verses.translation: But what can I help you?

translations.ron: Şi eu cu ce v-aş putea ajuta?
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ τί δυνατὴ βοηθῆσαι ὑμῖν; Ὁ γὰρ ἐπαγαγὼν τὰ κακὰ, ἐξελεῖται ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: For he that brought these plagues upon you will deliver you from the hands of your enemies.

translations.ron: Că Cel care v-a adus relele vă va scoate din mâna vrăjmaşilor voştri.
translations.grk: Βαδίζετε τέκνα, βαδίζετε, ἐγὼ γὰρ κατελείφθην ἔρημος.

verses.translation: Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate.

translations.ron: Duceţi-vă, fiilor, duceţi-vă, că eu am rămas pustie.
translations.grk: Ἐξεδυσάμην τὴν στολὴν τῆς εἰρήνης,

verses.translation: I have put off the clothing of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my prayer: I will cry unto the Everlasting in my days.

translations.ron: Dezbrăcatu-m-am de veşmântul păcii şi m-am îmbrăcat cu sacul rugăciunii mele, şi voi striga către Cel Veşnic în zilele mele:
translations.grk: ἐνεδυσάμην δὲ σάκκον τῆς δεήσεώς μου· κεκράξομαι πρὸς τὸν αἰώνιον ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου.

verses.translation: Be of good cheer, O my children, cry unto the Lord, and he shall deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.

translations.ron: Îndrăzniţi, fiilor, strigaţi către Dumnezeu şi El vă va scoate din silnica robie şi din mâna vrăjmaşilor.
translations.grk: Θαῤῥεῖτε τέκνα, βοήσατε πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ ἐξελεῖται ὑμᾶς ἐκ δυναστείας, ἐκ χειρος ἐχθρῶν.

verses.translation: For my hope is in the Everlasting, that he will save you: and joy is come unto me from the Holy One, because of the mercy which shall soon come unto you from the Everlasting your Saviour.

translations.ron: Că eu de la Cel Veşnic am nădăjduit izbăvirea voastră şi mi-a venit bucurie de la Cel Sfânt, pentru milostenia care va veni vouă degrab de la El.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤλπισα ἐπὶ τῷ αἰωνίῳ τὴν σωτηρίαν ὑμῶν· καὶ ἦλθέ μοι χαρὰ παρὰ τοῦ ἁγίου ἐπὶ τῇ ἐλεημοσύνῃ, ἣ ἥξει ὑμῖν ἐν τάχει παρὰ τοῦ αἰωνίου σωτῆρος ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but God will give you to me again with joy and gladness for ever.

translations.ron: Că v-am trimis cu plângere şi cu jale, şi vă va întoarce către mine Dumnezeu, cu bucurie şi veselie în veac.
translations.grk: Ἐξέπεμψα γὰρ ὑμᾶς μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ πένθους, ἀποδώσει δέ μοι ὁ Θεὸς ὑμᾶς μετὰ χαρμοσύνης καὶ εὐφροσύνης εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.translation: Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from your God, which shall come upon you with great glory, and brightness of the Everlasting.

translations.ron: Că precum au văzut acum vecinele Sionului robirea voastră, aşa vor vedea curând izbăvirea voastră de la Dumnezeul vostru, care va veni vouă cu slavă mare şi cu strălucirea Celui Veşnic.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ γὰρ νῦν ἑωράκασιν αἱ πάροικοι Σιὼν τὴν ὑμετέραν αἰχμαλωσίαν, οὕτως ὄψονται ἐν τάχει τὴν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν, ἣ ἐπελεύσεται ὑμῖν μετὰ δόξης μεγάλης καὶ λαμπρότητος τοῦ αἰωνίου.

verses.translation: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee; but shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck.

translations.ron: Fiilor! Îndelung răbdaţi mânia care v-a venit de la Dumnezeu. Vrăjmaşul te-a prigonit, dar vei vedea în curând pieirea lui şi pe grumajii lui vei pune piciorul tău.
translations.grk: Τέκνα μακροθυμήσατε τὴν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπελθοῦσαν ὑμῖν ὀργήν, κατεδίωξέ σε ὁ ἐχθρὸς, καὶ ὄψει αὐτοῦ τὴν ἀπώλειαν ἐν τάχει, καὶ ἐπὶ τραχήλους αὐτῶν ἐπιβήσῃ.

verses.translation: My delicate ones have gone rough ways, and were taken away as a flock caught of the enemies.

translations.ron: Copiii mei cei răsfăţaţi au mers pe căi aspre, au fost ridicaţi ca o turmă prădată de vrăjmaş.
translations.grk: Οἱ τρυφεροί μου ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδοὺς τραχείας, ᾔρθησαν ὡς ποίμνιον ἡρπασμένον ὑπὸ ἐχθρῶν.

verses.translation: Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry unto God: for ye shall be remembered of him that brought these things upon you.

translations.ron: Îndrăzniţi, fiilor, şi strigaţi către Dumnezeu, că Cel care v-a adus încercarea Îşi va aduce aminte de voi.
translations.grk: Θαρσήσατε τέκνα καὶ βοήσατε πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, ἔσται γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἐπάγοντος μνεία.

verses.translation: For as it was your mind to go astray from God: so, being returned, seek him ten times more.

translations.ron: Că precum a fost cugetul vostru, ca să vă abateţi de la Dumnezeu, întoarceţi-vă şi căutaţi-L de zece ori mai puternic.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐγένετο ἡ διάνοια ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ πλανηθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, δεκαπλασιάσατε ἐπιστραφέντες ζητῆσαι αὐτόν.

verses.translation: For he that hath brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy again with your salvation.

translations.ron: Că Acel Care v-a adus aceste nenorociri vă va aduce veşnică veselie odată cu mântuirea voastră.
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ ἐπαγαγὼν ὑμῖν τὰ κακὰ, ἐπάξει ὑμῖν τὴν αἱώνιον εὐφροσύνην μετὰ τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave thee that name will comfort thee.

translations.ron: Îndrăzneşte, Ierusalime, te va mângâia Cel care ţi-a dat un nume!
translations.grk: Θάρσει Ἱερουσαλήμ, παρακαλέσει σε ὁ ὀνομάσας σε.

verses.translation: Miserable are they that afflicted thee, and rejoiced at thy fall.

translations.ron: Vai de cei ce ţi-au făcut mult rău şi s-au bucurat de căderea ta!
translations.grk: Δείλαιοι οἱ σὲ κακώσαντες, καὶ ἐπιχαρέντες τῇ σῇ πτώσει·

verses.translation: Miserable are the cities which thy children served: miserable is she that received thy sons.

translations.ron: Vai cetăţilor ai căror robi au fost copiii tăi! Vai celei care a primit pe fiii tăi!
translations.grk: Δείλαιαι αἱ πόλεις αἷς ἐδούλευσαν τὰ τέκνα σου, δειλαία ἡ δεξαμένη τοὺς υἱούς σου.

verses.translation: For as she rejoiced at thy ruin, and was glad of thy fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.

translations.ron: Că precum ea s-a bucurat de căderea ta şi a fost fericită de ruina ta, aşa se va mâhni pentru pustiirea sa.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐχάρη ἐπὶ τῇ σῇ πτώσει, καὶ εὐφράνθη ἐπὶ τῷ πτώματί σου, οὕτως λυπηθήσεται ἐπὶ τῇ ἑαυτῆς ἐρημίᾳ.

verses.translation: For I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.

translations.ron: Şi voi lua de la ea bucuria ei de cetate cu popor mult şi semeţia ei va fi spre plângere.
translations.grk: Καὶ περιελῶ αὐτῆς τὸ ἀγαλλίαμα τῆς πολυοχλίας καὶ τὸ γαυρίαμα αὐτῆς εἰς πένθος.

verses.translation: For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.

translations.ron: Că un foc va veni peste ea de la Cel Veşnic, pentru zile îndelungate, şi va fi locuită de demoni multă vreme.
translations.grk: Πῦρ γὰρ ἐπελεύσεται αὐτῇ παρὰ τοῦ αἰωνίου εἰς ἡμέρας μακρὰς, καὶ κατοικηθήσεται ὑπὸ δαιμονίων τὸν πλείονα χρόνον.

verses.translation: O Jerusalem, look about thee toward the east, and behold the joy that cometh unto thee from God.

translations.ron: Priveşte către răsărit, Ierusalime, şi vezi bucuria care-ţi vine de la Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Περίβλεψον πρὸς ἀνατολὰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ἴδε τὴν εὐφροσύνην τὴν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ σοι ἐρχομένην.

verses.translation: Lo, thy sons come, whom thou sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of God.

translations.ron: Iată vin fiii tăi, pe care i-ai trimis, vin de la răsărit până la apus, adunaţi prin cuvântul Celui Sfânt, bucurându-se de slava lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχονται οἱ υἱοί σου οὓς ἐξαπέστειλας, ἔρχονται συνηγμένοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἕως δυσμῶν τῷ ῥήματι τοῦ ἁγίου, χαίροντες τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ δόξῃ.
